name: Backend Engineer Screening
steps: Open the ATS and navigate to the New tab for Backend Engineer applicants.
For each applicant, open their profile and read the resume file name to determine Python experience years and referral status.
Apply the rules to determine if the applicant is rejected or invited to an interview.
If invited, book a slot on the calendar and send the invite email.
If rejected, draft the rejection email for owner approval.
Update the ATS status to Interview or Rejected accordingly.

fields.name: python_years
fields.description: Years of Python experience extracted from resume

interview_invite.subject: Interview Invitation - Backend Engineer
interview_invite.body: Hi {name}, we would like to invite you for a 30-minute interview. Your slot is {slot}.

rejection_notice.subject: Update on your application
rejection_notice.body: Hi {name}, thank you for your interest in the Backend Engineer role. Unfortunately, we will not be moving forward with your application at this time.

notes: The resume file name is assumed to contain the years of experience; if it does not, the AI cannot determine the value.
The definition of 'afternoon' is interpreted as 14:00 to 17:00 start times.
